sources.note: Main product page. Describes VertexDr as integrated EMR and medical billing software with 20+ years in market. Mentions workflow management, data integration, interoperability (HL-7, ANSI, NCPDP, EDI), analytics, and RCM solutions.
News page with product updates. Mentions Meaningful Use Stage 3 compliance, Promoting Interoperability, text messaging module for appointment/billing reminders, PrecisionBI analytics, and EPCS.
VertexDr analytics/BI landing page. Describes advanced reporting engine, customizable workflows, and integration with clinical/reporting/accounting/hospital systems.

2019 press release on VertexDr enhancements. Lists core modules: scheduling, PM, EPCS, customizable EHR, mobile, automation. Mentions PrecisionBI analytics, text reminders, and Pediatrics Plus as a customer.
2016 press release announcing SSIMED (PM) and EMRge (EMR) rebranding to VertexDr. Confirms product was built from the ground up as integrated PM+EMR.
MTBC (now CareCloud) acquisition of Meridian Medical Management in June 2020 for ~$24.8M. Describes Meridian as former GE Healthcare IT company serving thousands of providers.

Meridian Medical Management corporate site. Describes RCM services, robotic process automation (Microbots), healthcare analytics, and technology solutions including PM and EMR. Notes they are 'EHR and PM system agnostic' for RCM services.

2014 acquisition of Origin Healthcare Solutions by Meridian. Expanded to 40,000+ providers. Added analytics platform (Origin Analytics). Broadened market to include small practices, ACOs, specialty groups, IDNs.
Hutchinson Clinic (118-provider multi-specialty group in Kansas) selected Meridian for RCM services. Confirms large multi-specialty group customer base.
The Polyclinic (Seattle multi-specialty group) selected Meridian. Another large multi-specialty customer reference.
Becker's coverage of SSIMED/EMRge to VertexDr rebranding. Confirms product positioning as medical billing product suite.

Attempted access for CareCloud history; returned 403. CareCloud history confirmed via other search results: MTBC founded 1999, acquired CareCloud Corp and Meridian in 2020, rebranded to CareCloud Inc in 2021.
Apps Run The World listing for Meridian Medical Management as a CareCloud company. Named top-tier software vendor.
